'''Tracey Gamble''' won the [[1997 DragonCon Open]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher named her among the 53 invited champions. She was unable to attend.<ref name="dec-sat">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/satsummary.html Saturday's Event Summary], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980224024206/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/satsummary.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I am 26, born April 13, 1971. As for my Education, I have a Bachelors Degree in Acting from Jacksonville State University in Alabama. I lived briefly in New York City, where I followed my dream of theatre. That's also where, in summer of '96, I played my first Star Wars CCG tournament, at Neutral Ground in Manhattan. I placed 6th, but it was enough to make me want more. I am currently employed as a Web developer for a large company in Birmingham, Alabama. I taught myself web design and the next thing you know I have a job. One day I plan to return to the stage and eventually do some film work -- the greatest thing would be a part in the next Star Wars Movie.(small plug incase anyone with pull reads this). I did mostly comedy on stage but also some serious stuff. In '95, I played Tom Joad in The Grapes Of Wrath (possibly the hardest part I ever did). I also played Dracula (my favorite part yet) in a Halloween special at Jacksonville."

"My favorite snack, C3P0's if you can get 'um. Most of the time they're stale."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gamble.html Tracey Gamble], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427184717/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/gamble.html Internet Archive]</ref>
